reviews.title: A good, fast, 4 TB NVMe SSD that used to be available from a now defunct brand
reviews.comment:
At the time that I purchased the P3 Plus NVMe SSD, it was quite literally the lowest-priced 4 TB M.2 2280 NVMe SSD available. Which is really unfortunate since Micron decided that AI datacenters are what they truly want to support and 4 TB SSDs of all stripes and creeds are now close to $1,000 per unit!
It's bad because this was actually a really affordable and quite fast SSD, with a very quick boot time and the high capacity makes it possible to have a few big virtual machines stored on it. Because it's an SSD, there's no risk of crashed disk platters or stuck heads like you have with hard disk drives and no noise since it's a non-mechanical storage device (which can be said for ANY brand of SSD, really).
I'm not certain if the P3 Plus uses TLC or QLC NAND flash memory, so I can't give it a proper score as to lifespan or data retentivity, but I feel fairly confident that this drive will be reliable in the long term. It IS Crucial by Micron, after all. They were known for reliable and affordable drives, and memory kits, too.
If Micron were still making these under their Crucial brand, I'd be recommending this SSD. It's fast, affordable and from a known brand that makes decent and reliable memory products.
reviews.author: Stephen B.

reviews.title: Reasonable price, good M.2
reviews.comment:
I dropped this into my Mac mini docking station, tightened one screw, put the cover back on, plugged it into the Mac mini, and that was basically the whole story. macOS recognized it instantly, asked if I wanted to format it, I clicked yes, and it was ready to go in about thirty seconds. No drivers, no nonsense, no troubleshooting spiral. Easily the smoothest drive install and format I’ve ever done.
Speeds are great for what I use this machine for. File transfers are fast, apps load instantly, and everything feels snappy. I’m not gaming on this system, so I can’t speak to how it performs there, but for normal desktop use it’s been rock solid with zero issues so far. It fits exactly into the m.2 slot, I didn't need the provided screw as my dock already had one.
Bottom line: it just works, it’s fast, and it didn’t waste my time. That alone puts it ahead of half the tech crap on the market.
reviews.author: Matt

reviews.title: Awesome Crucial1TB NVMe M.2 SSD!
reviews.comment:
I purchased this Crucial1TB PCIe NVMe M.2 SSD to use as a secondary file storage drive in the new Beelink SER8 Mini PC that I recently bought. This is the same exact 1TB Crucial SSD that already comes installed in the Beelink SER8 Mini PC as the boot drive, so they match perfectly. Also, since I have seen this question asked many times now, and I don't actually see the M.2 SSD slot size specification in the Amazon listing anywhere. This Crucial SSD is the longest size 2280 M.2 form factor. However, the M.2 2280 specification is actually shown on the Crucial SSD in the listing photos several times, but product photos aren't always accurate. This should hopefully clear up any confusion about the actual SSD size.
The Crucial line of products are all made by MICRON, one of the largest and highest quality memory manufacturers in the world, so they are all very high-quality computer memory and storage drive components. I usually either purchase Samsung or Crucial memory and storage drives when building or upgrading computers. However, Crucial components always seems to be "on-sale" for nearly half the price as the equivalent Samsung  products (as was this Crucial SSD), so most of the time I wnd up going with Crucial just for that reason.
This Crucial SSD installed easily into the second M.2 NVME drive slot on the Beelink SER8 Mini PC motherboard. It was also immediately recognized by Microsoft Windows 11 Professional on boot-up. This Crucial SSD initialized and formatted (GPT/NTFS) with no issues at all. Once up and running the file transfer read and write speeds are very fast, and the drive temperature stays relatively cool under burn-in stress tests.
Also, for those reviewers complaining that the actual capacity of these Crucial (or any other brand) SSDs is lower than advertised, that is perfectly normal. Due to computer "math" and memory overhead in any type of storage drive, the actually capacity will always be a little less than the advertised capacity. I have been an I.T. professional for over 25 years, so I have a lot of experience dealing with this drive capacity "issue."
Overall, I highly recommend these Crucial SSDs, as well as all other Crucial products. These Crucial SSDs are easy to install/configure, fast, inexpensive, and they run cool. In fact, I still have some older 2.5 inch Crucial SSDs that have been in service for over 12 years, and they are still running like they are brand new. Pick up one (or a few) of these Crucial SSDs today. Trust me when I say, they are a great product!
reviews.author: Todd C Blake

reviews.title: High speed and excellent value for money
reviews.comment: The 1TB Crucial P3 Plus was a perfect upgrade for my PC. Installation in M.2 format was quick and easy, and I noticed the improvement from the very first use: faster boot times, large file transfers in seconds, and stable performance in demanding games and programs. The compact design fits perfectly and feels secure. It definitely offers a great balance of speed, capacity, and price, making it a very worthwhile purchase.
reviews.author: Jonathan Céspedes

reviews.title: Instant Boot and Load Times
reviews.comment:
I upgraded my system with this Crucial P3 Plus 2TB PCIe Gen4 NVMe SSD and it’s been outstanding. Speeds are impressive, up to 5000 MB/s sequential reads, which makes booting and launching apps almost instantaneous
Installation was seamless; my motherboard recognized it immediately, and it’s fully compatible with Gen4 as well as backward compatible with Gen3. Whether I’m loading large files or transferring data, performance remains ultra-smooth.
The 2TB capacity gives me plenty of room for games, work files, and media, without compromising speed. Plus, the drive stays cool and reliable during extended use.
Overall, this drive delivers premium Gen4 performance at a very fair price.
